prose_updates.tldr: For any finite family of target-relevant unsupported finite-categorical shared rows, the fully Markovian relational causal set is exactly the compact interval obtained as the image of an explicit rational polynomial over the product of row simplices, and both endpoints have common finite-noise type-shared RSCM witnesses. The one unsupported binary row remains the tractable specialization: derivative-root isolation gives exact algebraic endpoints and a skeptical certificate checks the complete relational instance and endpoint models with polynomial size and checking cost. The structural classes explicitly require mutually independent distinct exogenous variables, no exogenous relational parents, and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables; they do not assume the comparator-only global parent-multiset bound. Ejaz--Bareinboim Definition 3.2 permits non-relational exogenous sharing only among attributes of the same instance, while their Section 5 neural-completeness domain is separate. On an instance in that domain, nonidentification transfers only under an explicit same-data, same-query class inclusion; neither the sharp interval nor singleton identification transfers to a strict superclass. Supported-row boxes use the multiplicative radius \(\delta_{\times}=1-\prod_r(1-\epsilon_r)^{m_r}\). The exhaustive assignment-level incidence grammar still has the stated treewidth-zero exponential obstruction.

project_justification.gap: The Ejaz--Bareinboim sound-and-complete neural identification result applies on its Section 5 domain but does not return the exact compatible causal range after nonidentification. Generic polynomial bounds likewise do not prove that every product-simplex parameter vector is realized by a type-shared fully Markovian RSCM or certify the relational derivation and endpoint models.
project_justification.niche: Finitely many unsupported finite-categorical rows admit an exact structural reduction to a rational polynomial on a product of simplices in an explicitly fully Markovian class. The one-binary-row case additionally admits efficient exact univariate algebraic certification. Comparator conclusions are stated only on the intersection with the published Section 5 domain and under an explicit compatible-class inclusion.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the multivariate structural sharp image with finite-noise endpoint witnesses, retains a sound and complete polynomial-size skeptical certificate for the univariate specialization, supplies a conservative sampling enclosure using a history-adaptive multiplicative occurrence-coupling radius, and separates its structural assumptions from the comparator-only global parent-multiset condition.

prose_updates.related_work: Ejaz and Bareinboim's Definition 3.2 separately requires no exogenous relational parent and permits a non-relational exogenous parent to be shared only by attributes of the same instance. Their Section 5 assumptions (I)--(III), rather than Definition 3.2 alone, specify the neural-completeness domain, including finite observed domains and one uniform finite bound on relational-parent multiset size over all admissible skeletons in the declared domain. Their Theorem 5.2 proves RNCM expressivity, while Algorithm 1 together with Appendix D, Corollary D.7 in arXiv v2 supplies sound and complete neural identification on that domain. The present exact image instead concerns the fully Markovian structural class with mutually independent distinct exogenous variables, no exogenous relational parents, and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables; the comparator-only global bound is not a premise of structural sharpness. On a Section 5 instance, a nonconstant image proves comparator-class nonidentification only after a same-data, same-query inclusion is established. Neither the subclass interval nor a constant subclass polynomial transfers as a sharp range or point-identification result to a strict superclass. Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim provide canonical finite-SCM polynomial programs, and Duarte et al. provide general numerical polynomial bounds and confidence-constraint relaxations; neither supplies this relational product-simplex realization theorem, exact univariate relational certificate, or multiplicative labeled-occurrence enclosure. Li, Passmore, and Paulson, Narkawicz, Mu\~noz, and Dutle, and Tsigaridas and Emiris supply the skeptical algebraic and root-isolation substrate. Hutschenreiter, Baier, and Klein identify a polynomial explicit-univariate model-checking core. Rossetto and Antonucci construct attaining models for order-based nonrelational bounds, but their witnesses do not impose the present type-shared fully Markovian semantics.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Structural soundness, completeness, compact interval form, endpoint attainment, and the finite breakpoint atom-count bound are proved for any finite family of unsupported finite-categorical rows in fully observed, acyclic, type-shared RSCMs with mutually independent distinct exogenous variables, no exogenous relational parents, and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables. The structural result does not require the comparator-only uniform parent-multiset bound. Exact derivative-root optimization, algebraic endpoint comparison, polynomial-size certificates, the sharp optimizer-degree guarantee, and the at-most-two algebraic-noise-mass guarantee remain specific to one unsupported binary row. Comparator statements are restricted to instances in the Ejaz--Bareinboim Section 5 domain and require an explicit same-data, same-query inclusion in the Definition 3.2 compatible class. Even then, only nonidentification transfers automatically; the interval is not claimed sharp for a strict superclass, and singleton identification transfers only under class equality. Efficient exact multivariate optimization, compact circuit-level incidence, conditional postintervention queries, exact nuisance-box projection, and empirical usefulness beyond the documented N3 example remain open. The sampling enclosure has simultaneous coverage and uses \(\delta_{\times}\leq\min\{1,\sum_rm_r\epsilon_r\}\); it is deliberately conservative.
